description: Human extraction and correction against an extrct variables set
notes: Machine-readable half of README.md — the two must not drift; change both in one commit.
Uids are sha256(canonical_json(body))[:16]. Timestamps and durations ride storage rows, never the hash.
Two modes, one contract: blind (empty form) and review (form seeded from LLM output; seed recorded).

inputs.name: variables_set
inputs.contract: schema variables (registry or schema JSON export)
inputs.description: The variables set the form is rendered from, loaded via the library — never redefined or copied into the app.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.identified_by: input_uid (sha256 of the record text, always computed) + optional user id column
inputs.description: Records to annotate. Column roles (text / id / llm_output) are inferred from structure and data types, then confirmed by the user before any record is shown; the confirmed mapping is remembered per dataset shape.

inputs.name: llm_output
inputs.contract: JSON values conforming to the schema `schema_uid` names
inputs.description: Review mode only: pre-fills the form. May arrive as a dataset column or a separate JSON/JSONL file joined by input id. Records failing schema validation are flagged and open blind with the raw JSON shown read-only.

outputs.name: annotation
outputs.written_to: library storage (SQLite default, Postgres when configured)

schema_uid.description: Pins the annotation to the exact schema it was collected against.

input_uid.description: The user's own record id (from the confirmed id column), when one exists.

input_text_sha256.description: Full digest of the source text — always computed; hash, don't keep.

seed.description: Review mode only: what pre-filled the form, so human-LLM deltas stay computable.

values_sha256.description: sha256(canonical_json(seed values)) as loaded, before any human edit.

skip_reason.description: Present instead of meaningful values when the record was skipped; values must then be null/empty per the schema.

values.description: Must validate against the exact schema `schema_uid` names — the same validator model output goes through. Optional absent fields are explicit null (strict_nullable), never dropped keys.

outputs.name: export
outputs.contract: projection of stored annotation-def/1.0 documents with all identity columns
outputs.identified_by: annotation_uid per row — the projection carries the document ids it projects
outputs.description: Round-trip requirement: re-importing an export reproduces identical annotation_uids, idempotent in storage. Import also accepts bare annotation-def/1.0 JSON/JSONL.
